about.title: About Kalmate
about.subtitle: Kalmate is a free, professional financial terminal built for modern web. It provides real-time market data, professional charts, portfolio tracking, and advanced tools — all at zero cost.

why.title: Why Kalmate?
why.p1: Financial data tools are expensive. Professional terminals cost thousands per year. We built Kalmate to democratize access to real-time market intelligence — completely free, no sign-up required.
why.p2: Powered by Yahoo Finance and TradingView charts, Kalmate delivers professional-grade market analysis directly in your browser.

features.title: Features
items: Real-time Data — Equities, forex, bonds, commodities, and crypto
Professional Charts — TradingView-powered with full technical analysis
Portfolio Tracking — Monitor holdings with real-time P&L
Smart Screener — Find opportunities across thousands of instruments
Data Pipeline — Build custom analysis workflows with visual nodes

info.title: 1. Information We Collect
info.p1: Kalmate does not require user registration or accounts. We do not collect personal information such as names, email addresses, or payment data.
info.p2: We may collect anonymous usage data through third-party services to improve our service.

cookies.title: 2. Cookies
cookies.p1: Kalmate uses cookies and similar technologies for the following purposes:
items: Advertising: Google AdSense uses cookies to serve personalized ads based on your browsing activity.
Analytics: We may use analytics services to understand how users interact with the site.
Functional: Local storage is used to save your portfolio data (stored locally in your browser, not on our servers).

adsense.title: 3. Google AdSense
adsense.p1: We use Google AdSense to display advertisements. Google uses cookies to serve ads based on users' visits to this site and other websites.
adsense.p2: You can opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings.
adsense.p3: As a third-party vendor, Google uses cookies to serve ads on our site. Google's use of the DART cookie enables it to serve ads based on your visits to this site and other sites on the Internet.

thirdParty.title: 4. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.p1: Kalmate integrates with the following third-party services:

storage.title: 5. Data Storage
storage.p1: Portfolio positions, alerts, and pipeline configurations are stored locally in your browser using localStorage. We do not transmit or store this data on our servers.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights
rights.p1: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or port your data. Since we do not store personal data on our servers, most of these rights are managed through your browser settings.

financial-terminal.title: What Is a Financial Terminal and Why Do You Need One?
financial-terminal.excerpt: Bloomberg costs $24K/year. Kalmate is free. Compare costs, explore 29 symbols across 6 asset classes, and see real-time AAPL data in action.

steps.title: Welcome to Pipeline Builder
steps.text: Visual pipeline builder for financial analysis. Connect nodes to create strategies without code.

steps.title: Add Nodes
steps.text: Click the FREE/Pro buttons on the toolbar to add nodes to the canvas. Each node has inputs (blue) and outputs (green).

steps.title: Connect Nodes
steps.text: Drag from an output port (green) to an input port (blue) to connect nodes. The flow goes from left to right.

steps.title: Available Nodes
steps.text: Input: Symbol Input, Price Feed. Process: Kalman Filter. Output: Chart, Price Display, Alert.

steps.title: Pro Nodes
steps.text: SMA, RSI, Price Forecast, Multi Symbol, Telegram, Email. Upgrade on Pricing to unlock.

steps.title: Run Pipeline
steps.text: Press Run to execute the pipeline. Results appear on each node and in the side panel.
